description: By means of Nepal's dynamic cities, rich cultural legacy, and historical sites, City Tour Nepal presents an immersive experience The trips combine spirituality, history, and natural beauty from the busy streets of Kathmandu with its UNESCO-listed sites like Pashupatinath Temple, Swayambhunath (Monkey Temple), and Kathmandu Durbar Square to the calm beauty of Pokhara, known for Phewa Lake and the Annapurna range. Visitors can visit the ancient city of Bhaktapur, Patan's artistic appeal, and Chitwan's forest adventures. Whether you're interested in temples, traditional markets, or breathtaking mountain vistas, City Tour Nepal offers an amazing tour into the heart of the country’s culture and environment.
